_doc: Live theme list used by vpscreen-scan to PRIORITISE which forum-discovery candidates get researched first when the Step 0.5 trusted/elevated priority queue is drained. A discovery thread whose title/slug/excerpt matches a theme's keywords is researched ahead of a non-matching ('random') discovery candidate; priority-1 themes ahead of priority-2; within a bucket, most-recent first (the existing recency rule). This does NOT change the discovery MECHANISM (still discover.py, recency-sorted, not reply-count) — it re-ranks the shortlist by theme relevance. Method: playbook/ishmohit-soic-style.md. | priority 1 = accelerating global tailwind (research first), 2 = steady / human-set / secondary, 3 = dormant (cooling; global-proxy-scan sets this after 2 decelerating reads — deprioritise but do not drop).
maintained_by: seeded 2026-08-30 from global_bellwethers.json (accelerating tailwinds) + playbook/ishmohit-soic-style.md section 3; global-proxy-scan light-refreshes priority/as_of on themes it re-reads; a human can add/retire entries here directly; 2026-08-31 two themes (capital-markets financialisation, shipbuilding & maritime) added by user-directed x-cluster expansion.
match_rule: case-insensitive substring match of any keyword against the discovery thread's title + slug + excerpt (and the candidate company name). A hit on ANY keyword = a match for that theme.
